fact: Researchers report an AI tax-fraud detection system for Cameroon, tested at three tax centres, that cut processing time by 67% and generated additional revenue (amount not disclosed), with 97.2% precision on 3.2 million records; no DGI document corroborated the pilot as of 25 August 2026.
title: Cameroon-Built AI Claims 97.2% Precision in Tax Fraud Detection, but Revenue Impact Remains Unclear
